summary: This class models the Printers screen and related printer management flows in the Android Smart app. It provides comprehensive automation support for printer discovery, connection, and setup across different Android versions (7-12+). The class handles multiple printer connection types including WiFi, Ethernet, WiFi Direct, and OOBE (Out-of-Box-Experience) printers. It includes extensive verification methods for validating UI states, permission handling for location and Bluetooth services, and version-specific UI element handling. The class follows a pattern of action methods (select_*, search_*, connect_*) for user interactions and verification methods (verify_*) for assertion checks. It inherits from SmartFlow base class and uses Selenium WebDriver for element interactions with robust error handling including retry logic and fallback mechanisms.
